basics.name: Chandana M
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software Engineer with 1+ year of experience building and debugging production web applications using JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, RESTful APIs, and SQL databases. Experienced in developing full-stack product features, integrating backend services, working with data-driven applications, and integrating LLM APIs to generate Candidate Development Reports. Strong foundation in software development, debugging, problem-solving, and collaborative Git-based workflows.

work.name: Curatal
highlights: Developed and maintained production application features using JavaScript, Node.js, React.js, RESTful APIs, and PostgreSQL.
Built reusable React.js components and integrated backend services through REST APIs using Axios and React Query.
Developed data-driven product workflows including search, filtering, pagination, dynamic rendering, and API-based functionality.
Integrated LLM APIs into the product to generate Candidate Development Reports, transforming candidate-related data into structured development insights.
Debugged application and API issues, performed root-cause analysis, and contributed to performance, reliability, and maintainability improvements.
